$comment: Interior themes (D-017). Each book gets its own theme so no two look alike. Fonts are SIL OFL 1.1 families installed for the prototype and listed in assets/fonts/README.md. Body text stays 10 to 12 pt for adult books (picture books larger) with line height 1.2 to 1.5. Margins: the inside margin always comes from the KDP rule paperback.interiorMargins (unverified, so preflight warns); themes only add extraInsideIn and set outside, top and bottom. Sizes are points; margins inches.
